telemetry.interpretation: Whole-verifier context only. System CPU is interval utilization across logical CPUs including this benchmark; process cpu_core_percent is relative to one logical CPU and may exceed 100. The first CPU observation is excluded. Cumulative disk deltas cover only adjacent valid samples. PID/create_time changes, unavailable processes and counter resets are never bridged or filled with zero. Nominal 200ms polling includes acquisition and scheduling gaps; missing-periodic counts estimate skipped nominal slots. No per-query interpolation, process-specific slowdown causality, Ollama token speed or optimization claim follows. Observer work remains part of this measured environment.

diagnostics.interpretation: Diagnostic observers retain frozen SQL, lazy row iteration, checkpoint operations and original wall timers. Execute and fetch include SQLite stepping and Python DB-API tuple conversion; their wall residual includes Python validation, pool construction, watch, proxy bookkeeping and clock overhead, not pure Python conversion. Terminal EOF fetch is included in fetch totals. Append budget read_text includes UTF-8 decoding; JSON parsing preserves the original nonfinite rejection. Deadline/accounting and writer/context residuals include observer dispatch. Budget publication wrappers include the original V5 observer; original direct budget and nested commits keep their original cost allocation. Thread CPU excludes other threads including telemetry, but clock quantization can make it exceed wall in short spans. Signed wall-minus-thread-CPU is retained without clamping; it is not I/O wait or proof of OS, cache, disk or Ollama causation. FunctionType namespace allocation, per-cursor event bookkeeping and clock reads remain observed instrumentation overhead; reference/diagnostic differences are descriptive and provide no deterministic correction. Component totals conserve their own enclosing spans and must not be added across nested levels. Direct append observes only the three original exists calls and the original key format validation. Writer includes acceptance; guard residual retains ordinal/key ordering, first reconstruction checks and observer dispatch. Nested checkpoint calls are unmodified. No exists call is added, cached or suppressed. No residual is pure identity validation or I/O wait.

interpretation.query_spread: Per-repeat row statistics compare distinct fixed queries within one cell.
interpretation.temporal_variation: Ranges and signed later-minus-earlier pairs compare the same query within its original cohort only.
interpretation.weighting: No population-weighted scenario is published. Each segment deliberately selects its eligible maximum and one remaining hash-selected query; these samples and the reused anchor are not a uniform sample of the cell or its tail.
interpretation.accounting: Rank contains vote SQL and is nested in verification. Core is same-row verification plus append excluding nested commit and direct budget writes. Component medians must not be added. Setup, tail, all chunk commits and budget totals are separate overlapping diagnostics, not extra disjoint costs.
interpretation.limits: Seven fixed identities in one engineering window provide no confidence interval, causal speedup, future latency guarantee or full-run runtime bound. Telemetry describes each whole repeat, not per-query or process-specific causation.
interpretation.tail_reinforcement: No reinforcement selection occurs in V21. All seven V19 identities are reused; source tail and source anchor labels describe their earlier provenance only.

interpretation.diagnostic_mode: Observational diagnostics D, including instrumentation overhead

fixed_cases.interpretation: Each structural case identifies one previously exposed V19 query without publishing its key or ordinal. Every component difference uses the exact same fastest/slowest observations selected by the stated metric; independently chosen maxima are never added.

paired_observations.interpretation: Adjacent same-identity diagnostic-minus-reference observations include instrumentation, system load and temporal variation. They are not an optimization speedup or an isolated causal observer-overhead estimate.

interpretation.reference: R keeps the frozen V4 verifier, SQL and V6 detailed checkpoint store.
interpretation.diagnostic: D observes the same workload through invocation-local proxies. Original scientific output, original timers and checkpoint protocol remain fixed; diagnostic instrumentation adds observer overhead.
interpretation.append_scope: Fine diagnostic observations cover active per-query append, including its budget check. Setup and tail retain original V6 accounting; do not extend this diagnostic coverage to unobserved paths.
interpretation.clocks: Wall time and current-thread CPU time use separate monotonic clocks. Thread CPU excludes the concurrent telemetry thread. Wall minus thread CPU is a signed clock difference and may be negative because of accounting resolution; it is not measured waiting time or an identified disk, scheduler or Ollama cause.
interpretation.telemetry: One continuous inherited sampler covers each full verifier entry. Six sequential segments use within-mode repeat indices 0..2 and separate global round indices 0..5. Background observer overhead remains in the environment and is not added to primary timers.
interpretation.inference: All 42 observations reuse seven known validation identities. No population runtime projection, speedup claim, causal attribution or coverage gain follows.
